hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; f=json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); print(f) if f else None" | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; PB=node_modules/.bin; if [ -x "$PB/prettier" ]; then "$PB/prettier" --write "$f" --ignore-unknown; else npx prettier --write "$f" --ignore-unknown; fi && if [ -x "$PB/eslint" ]; then "$PB/eslint" --fix "$f"; else npx eslint --fix "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
